name: capiro-build-intel-api
description: Build+push intel-api ARM64 image to ECR and force-deploy capiro-dev-intel-api. Created out-of-band (local Docker unavailable).

source.buildspec:
version: 0.2
phases:
  pre_build:
    commands:
      - echo Logging into ECR...
      - aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
  build:
    commands:
      - echo Building intel-api image native arm64...
      - docker build -f apps/intel-api/Dockerfile -t 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/capiro/dev/intel-api:latest .
  post_build:
    commands:
      - echo Pushing image...
      - docker push 967807252336.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/capiro/dev/intel-api:latest
      - echo Forcing service redeploy...
      - aws ecs update-service --cluster capiro-dev --service capiro-dev-intel-api --force-new-deployment --region us-east-1
      - echo Done.
